commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
90+1' Half-chance! Rodrygo (Real Madrid) plays a pass into the box, but Unai Simon reacts well to snuff out the attack.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
88' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
85' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
83' Real Madrid take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

82' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Unai Simon was alert and made a comfortable save. Real Madrid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
82' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
81' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play. Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
79' The attendance is 51313.
78' We are about to witness a substitution. Selton Sanchez (Ath Bilbao) is replacing Nico Williams.
78' A substitution has been made. Vinicius Junior is replaced by Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid).
78' Xabi Alonso decides to make a substitution. Kylian Mbappe will be replaced by Rodrygo (Real Madrid).
78' Substitution. Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid) in, Eder Militao out.
76' Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Jesus Manzano ignores the protests.
74' The ball is cleared after Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
72' Ath Bilbao can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
71' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
71' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play. Ath Bilbao will have a chance to score from a corner.
69' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Eduardo Camavinga leaves the pitch to be replaced by Arda Guler (Real Madrid).
69' Ernesto Valverde has decided to substitute Mikel Jauregizar and he is replaced by Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao).
69' Substitution. Alex Berenguer makes way for Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao).
68' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
66' A yellow card for a tackle by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao). Jesus Manzano doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
65' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
64' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Real Madrid.
61' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid).

59' 0 - 3 Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) scores an incredible goal! He receives a pass, makes some space for himself and unleashes a long-range thunderbolt of a shot past the goalkeeper into the left side of the net.
59' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
57' Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jesus Manzano has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
55' Trent Alexander-Arnold is substituted due to injury. Xabi Alonso gives a chance to Raul Asencio (Real Madrid).
55' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
53' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
52' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
52' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Real Madrid earn a corner.
51' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is flagged for offside.
49' Ath Bilbao have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

49' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the roof of the net and forces a good save out of Thibaut Courtois. Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
48' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
47' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
46' Ernesto Valverde has decided to make a change. Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) replaces Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Inigo Lekue departs the field of play to be replaced by Jesus Areso (Ath Bilbao).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
42' 0 - 2 Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) finds some space inside the box and powers his header past the goalkeeper, giving him no chance.
41' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
40' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
39' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Real Madrid.
37' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) gets in a promising position inside the box after a rebound, but his resulting header to the middle of the target is too weak and the goalkeeper saves it easily.
35' The ball is cleared after Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
33' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
31' The foul by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) was seen by Jesus Manzano who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

30' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Thibaut Courtois is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
29' Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
28' Great teamplay by Real Madrid as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
26' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ath Bilbao.

26' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the top left corner. Thibaut Courtois is alert and denies him with a nice save. Good work from Ath Bilbao as they win a corner.
25' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
23' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
21' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
20' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
19' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Now Real Madrid have a corner.
18' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
17' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
16' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
14' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) latches onto a brilliant cross and fires the ball towards goal, but his shot goes high over the crossbar.
13' The resulting set piece from Real Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
12' Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
10' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Kylian Mbappe, but Unai Simon displays great awareness to stop him.

7' 0 - 1 Goal! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box inside the right post. Unai Simon had no chance of reaching it. The score is 0:1.
5' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
5' What an amazing save by Unai Simon! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the left side of the target, but fails.
4' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
2' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
1' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) commits a rough foul. Jesus Manzano stops the game and makes a call.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Ath Bilbao will kick the game off.
